note: vespera_macro request views: a type whose request view differs but that only request bodies reach (no response, directly or through another type) keeps its own component name — {Name} is its request view and no {Name}Input or orphan response view is emitted (0.8.0 renamed request-only DTOs to {Name}Input); types read and returned keep {Name} + {Name}Input (collision names {Name}Input2, ... unchanged). Fields read by a custom serde function (deserialize_with / with) are documented from their Rust type (or #[schema(value_type)]) in request views instead of an untyped {} — Option<Option<T>> is a nullable T — and a deserialize_with alone no longer creates a {Name}Input; with / serialize_with still document {} in responses. Response views follow what serde writes: Option<T> fields are required (nullable type; serde writes null) unless skip_serializing_if, and an Option skipped by skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none" (serde_with #[skip_serializing_none]) is optional and not nullable since null is never written, and skip_serializing fields are absent instead of an optional writeOnly property; request views keep Option<T> optional, so a type with Option fields used on both sides gets a {Name}Input.
